permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The Department and it representatives have the right to enter and inspect any facility or property in accordance with N.J.A.C. 7:27-1.31(a)1-8; and No person shall obstruct, hinder or delay the Department or its representatives in its exercise of its rights.
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Primary permit identifier taken from 'Permit Activity ID Number: GEN250001'. Program Interest No / Facility ID No also present as 32741. Approval Date on cover used as permit issuance date.

generatorSets.fuelGrade: Diesel*, Number two fuel oil (No. 2)* or kerosene
generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: not to exceed 100 hours per year per emergency generator
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The EG(s) shall be operated only under the following situations: (a) During the performance of normal testing and maintenance procedures, as recommended in writing by the manufacturer, the facility's standard operating procedure, and/or as required in writing by a Federal or State law or regulation; or (b) When there is a power outage or the facility's primary source of mechanical or thermal energy fails because of an emergency; or (c) When there is a voltage reduction issued by PJM and posted on the PJM internet website.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Equipment description and capacities taken from permit equipment table (21.47 MMBTU/Hr; 2000 kW). Fuel constraints and sulfur limit (15 ppm) taken from GP-005A facility specific requirements.
